mapper.select: SELECT pm.is_charge,pm.id, pm.member_id,pm.member_name, pm.create_time,pm.create_user_id,pm.create_user_name FROM project_members pm WHERE pm.product_id =#{productId} AND pm.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY pm.create_time DESC

SELECT pm.is_charge,pm.id, ref.id AS roleRefMemberId,pr.id AS roleId,pr.name AS roleName, pm.member_id,pm.member_name,pm.create_time,pm.create_user_id,pm.create_user_name FROM project_members pm INNER JOIN role_ref_members ref on ref.members_id=pm.id INNER JOIN project_role pr on ref.role_id=pr.id WHERE pm.product_id =#{productId} AND ref.product_id=#{productId} AND pm.is_deleted = FALSE
AND pr.id IN
#{roleId}
ORDER BY pm.create_time DESC
